HISTORY OF IEEE SB MBITS

The IEEE Student Branch at Mar Baselios Institute of Technology and Science (MBITS) was established on 3rd July 2022 with an initial membership of 34 students. The branch was founded with the vision of promoting technical excellence, innovation, professional development, and active student engagement within the institution.

The branch was initially guided by Dr. Robin George, Assistant Professor in the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), and led by its first Student Branch Chair, Dileep Kumar A., from the ECE Department. The official inauguration was conducted by Dr. Rajesh M. V, who served as the Chairman of the IEEE Kochi Subsection at the time.

At present, the branch is guided by Prof. Minu Mary Joy, Assistant Professor in the Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE), serving as the Student Branch Counselor. Under the guidance of its leadership and dedicated student volunteers, IEEE SB MBITS has witnessed significant growth, expanding its membership to 188 students from various departments.

Since its inception, IEEE SB MBITS has established several active Student Branch Chapters and Affinity Groups, including the IEEE Signal Processing Society (SPS), IEEE Circuits and Systems Society (CASS), IEEE Women in Engineering (WIE) Affinity Group, IEEE Computer Society (CS), and the IEEE Sensors Council. These chapters and groups contribute significantly to the technical and professional development of students by organizing workshops, technical talks, coding competitions, hackathons, awareness programs, and other engaging activities.

Through these initiatives, IEEE SB MBITS continues to foster a vibrant ecosystem of innovation, collaboration, leadership, and technical excellence, empowering students to explore emerging technologies and actively contribute to the broader IEEE community.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

What is IEEE and why should I join? +

IEEE is the world's largest technical professional organization dedicated to advancing technology for humanity. By joining, you gain access to cutting-edge research, networking opportunities, career resources, and technical publications that can significantly enhance your professional development.

How can I become a member of IEEE MBITS Student Branch? +

Students from MBITS can join by registering through our dedicated membership portal. You need to be enrolled at MBITS and have an interest in technology and engineering. Membership includes access to all our events, workshops, technical chapters, and global resources.

What activities and events do you organize? +

We organize technical workshops, guest lectures from industry experts, hackathons, research projects, networking events, and innovation labs. We also participate in IEEE competitions and collaborate on entrepreneurship initiatives.

Are there any membership fees? +

IEEE Student membership has a nominal annual fee that provides access to IEEE resources including IEEE Xplore Digital Library, career guidance, and exclusive student benefits. The fee is significantly discounted for students with a 50% half-year offer.

Can I participate in research projects? +

Absolutely! We encourage student participation in research projects. We collaborate with faculty and industry partners on various research initiatives, and members can contribute to publications and present their work at IEEE conferences.
